messages:
Rachel (Support): Escalation inbound: SignalGrid trial tenant sg-trial-7 is hitting embed timeouts during a bulk ingest. Customer-facing demo next week; they're worried. @Omar can CS pick this up? :bangbang:
Priya (CS): On it. Rachel, can you paste the console alert and any client-side changes they made?
Rachel (Support): Console alert shows per-tenant throttle spikes. Snippet:

```
2026-04-02T11:02:05Z WARN embed-service tenant=sg-trial-7 rate=720/s limit=400/s quota_exceeded
2026-04-02T11:02:06Z ERROR client sdk timeout request_id=abc123
```

Rachel (Support): They said they flipped "concurrency=12" in their SDK yesterday while ramping ingestion.
Omar (CSM): Risk summary: onboarding stall -> demo failure -> renewal pressure. Comms + ops proposal: 1) immediate ack + scheduled triage call, 2) temporary throughput uplift for 12-24h, 3) short enablement on SDK batching, 4) record product feedback about SDK defaults. I'll own customer comms and enablement.
Diego (Eng): Likely cause: client concurrency spiked above tenant burst credit; cluster in us-east-1 at ~85% for embed workers. Short-term: bump soft limit to 900/s and enable smoothing. Mid-term: recommend client-side batching and autoscale policy change for embed fleet.
Omar (CSM): Draft external note (keeps infra light):

"Hi SignalGrid team 7 thanks for raising this. We're investigating a throttling issue affecting embed requests during your recent ingest. We've scheduled a troubleshooting call with our engineers and will temporarily raise throughput to avoid blocking demos. We'll also run a short enablement session on batching and SDK settings. Meeting invite coming.  Omar, CSM"

Priya (CS): Add a quick offer: temporary demo window monitoring and a short checklist that covers SDK concurrency defaults.
Omar (CSM): Added. Sending message now.
revops-bot: [meeting] Created incident-sg-1765501234 meeting at 2026-04-02T12:30:00Z; attendees: Omar, Diego, Rachel, Priya
Rachel (Support): Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate quick help. Can you uplift now for our internal demo at 13:00?"
Diego (Eng): I'll prepare the uplift command and monitoring query. Won't run until we confirm on the call. Rollback to 400/s after 24h if no commit.
Omar (CSM): Action items: - Omar: send ack + run enablement. - Diego: prep uplift and health dashboards. - Rachel: collect exact SDK flags they changed and sample failed requests. - Priya: prepare AE/RevOps note in case mitigation extends.
Priya (CS): I'll flag renewal/watch if we exceed 24h and capture sentiment in account health.
Diego (Eng): Uplift preview (for call):

```
# preview
PATCH /internal/quotas/tenants/sg-trial-7 { "soft_limit": 900 }
# monitor: /metrics?tenant=sg-trial-7&last=5m
```

Diego (Eng): Will post exact CLI on the call and await verbal confirmation.
Omar (CSM): Reminder to keep external comms non-technical until customer asks. We'll file SDK default change as product feedback if they agree.
Rachel (Support): I'll update the support ticket with the SDK flag and attach request traces.
Priya (CS): Thanks everyone. After resolution, I'll update the account health playbook with RCA and recommended follow-ups. :thumbsup:
Omar (CSM): Post-call I'll attach meeting notes and enablement recording to the account record.
Rachel (Support): -- end thread --
